author: lxx-translators

lemma.el: πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐπεφέρετο ἐπάνω τοῦ ὕδατος
lemma.en: a spirit of God was borne upon the water

original.text: ἡ δὲ γῆ ἦν ἀόρατος καὶ ἀκατασκεύαστος, καὶ σκότος ἐπάνω τῆς ἀβύσσου, καὶ πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐπεφέρετο ἐπάνω τοῦ ὕδατος.

english.text: But the earth was unsightly and unfurnished, and darkness was over the deep, and the Spirit of God moved over the water.

notes: ἐπεφέρετο ('was borne upon') is the reading every Latin 'ferebatur / superferebatur' descends from. The Greek already drops the bird: the verb is motion-over, not brooding.
